name: hertz_pressure_profile_comparison
caption: Contact pressure profile: TensorFEM ALM load-controlled solution vs Hertz analytic closed form. Parameters: R=10 mm, E=100 GPa, ν=0.3, a/R=0.05, h/a=1.5%, domain depth H/a=96. Contact radius error -0.53%, indentation error -1.01%, peak pressure error +0.49% (consistent formulation). The ALM (augmented Lagrangian multiplier) method enforces the Signorini contact constraint without penalty bias.
